reviewRisk.reason: stale schedule generation can create or duplicate durable Event records; permission, persistence, and real-route boundaries

review.reviewer: Verify623 (fresh-context reviewer, independent Spec + Acceptance route): verdict correct; every checkbox PASS except the empty-Plan Worker/D1 case and the real-route pair, which the delivery owner then ran

criteria.expected: Preview returns a Reviewed Schedule Plan bound to the visible date range plus the authoritative Schedule Rule and saved-exception versions/fingerprint.
criteria.actual: computePlanHash hashes horizon_days, from_date, rules (version = updated_at) and exceptions (version = created_at); the plan row persists plan_id, schedule_version and reviewed_at through replacePreviewPlan (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:3348-3512, web/lib/programs/d1-workspace-store.ts:2203-2317). Independently re-ran the Worker/D1 range, rule-version, and exception-version preview tests.

criteria.expected: Changing the range, a Rule, a saved exception, or an unsaved exception draft makes the old Preview outdated and non-actionable.
criteria.actual: The panel compares the preview's input fingerprint, scheduleMutationVersion and visible range against current inputs, and additionally blocks on drafts, exceptionBusy and a null rule set (web/lib/programs/workspace-events-task.tsx:409-429, :601, :1168-1177). Independent component re-runs showed the Cantonese stale guidance and disabled Generate for range, unsaved-draft, pending-save and unknown-save states.

criteria.expected: A pending, failed, or unknown exception save keeps generation blocked until reconciliation.
criteria.actual: exceptionBusy and the unresolved-save path keep Generate disabled and the submit handler returns early; the independent verifier re-ran the pending-save and unknown-save component cases. The live saved-exception network-failure journey remains unrun (see limitations).

criteria.expected: Server validation rejects a stale or mismatched Plan even when a client bypasses the UI guards; a fresh matching Preview restores Generate.
criteria.actual: The Worker/D1 implementation re-derives Plan currency before any write and maps stale plans to 409 STALE_PLAN, while the component guards wait for authoritative Rules and require Review Again after a range change (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:3545-3598, web/lib/programs/program-handlers.ts:277-279, web/lib/programs/workspace-events-task.tsx:1001-1010). The referenced route artifact is historical Candidate 0d9f1fd1, not commit:d8e2eb43, and no fresh candidate-bound route rerun is available; this criterion remains unverified for the candidate.

criteria.expected: Preview, save, and Generate stay distinct operations; generation is date-bounded, retains occurrence provenance and reports existing/skipped/rescheduled/created/unfinished outcomes truthfully.
criteria.actual: Preview writes only plan and occurrence rows; generation reports created/skipped/failed/requires_review with created_event_ids and unresolved occurrences (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:3748-3796) and records schedule-rule plus occurrence-date provenance. Independently re-ran the idempotent repeat (created=2 then created=0/skipped=2, same run_id) and the mid-generation stale partial case.

criteria.expected: Retry and resume are durable, idempotent, duplicate-safe, and any stale partial requires a new Plan.
criteria.actual: The atomic occurrence guard plus finishGenerationRun make resume duplicate-safe; the independent verifier re-ran resume, conflict, retry and duplicate-protection tests, and also injected a mid-generation staleness that settles as a truthful partial with requires_review. Browser interruption/restart injection remains unrun (see limitations).

criteria.expected: Finite and ongoing Rules keep per-rule inclusive dates; an ongoing Preview defaults to the next three calendar months with explicit adjustable dates.
criteria.actual: isWithinRuleLifetime is inclusive at both ends and excludes retired rules (web/lib/programs/recurrence.ts:142-154); the panel defaults from/to to addWallMonths(today, 3) - 1 day. The independent verifier re-ran the inclusive-bound and month-omission cases and the three-calendar-month default. A Worker/D1 regression now persists a zero-occurrence Plan, POSTs generate, and proves the server returns 422 VALIDATION without Event or generation-run writes (web/lib/programs/programs.test.ts:5917-5950).

criteria.expected: Package evidence is candidate-bound and receives fresh independent Spec plus Acceptance review.
criteria.actual: Candidate d8e2eb43 has candidate-bound Worker/D1 and component manifests: the full Worker suite passed 676/676 and the full component suite passed 1199/1199, including the empty-Plan regression. The cited historical route artifact remains non-candidate-bound and no fresh independent candidate-bound review is available, so R52.1 remains unverified.

limitations: The superseded 6cc9a5d9 record's local run manifests were hand-authored rather than runner-emitted and its 'independent review' cited only its own trace; this record replaces that evidence with runner-emitted artifacts and a real independent reviewer verdict.

Empty-Plan generation is now covered by a Worker/D1 test that persists a zero-occurrence Plan, POSTs generate, asserts 422 VALIDATION, and proves no Event or generation-run rows are written (web/lib/programs/programs.test.ts:5917-5950).

Browser interruption/restart injection during generation and the saved-exception live network-failure journey remain unrun; these are explicit real-route gaps, not inferred from component or Worker/D1 evidence.
Physical device, QR, native print, Owner L2, merge, deployment, release, and issue closure remain outside this record.
